entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
I need to return the VeloBand I bought.
Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a preference. I just don't want it.
I understand. Let me just pull up your order details... I see you received it 13 days ago. I'm just checking the policy for that model... It looks like it has a 10-day return window.
Whatever. I tried returning it last week, on day 9. Your whole site was experiencing a website error. I couldn't print the label.

Oh, you tried to start the return process last week? Let me check our system status for that day. I do see a notification that our return portal system was down for a few hours that day. We were getting reports that customers couldn't print their labels. Did you happen to take a screenshot of the error message?
No. I assumed you knew your own system was broken. I'm not tech support.
No, of course not. I completely understand. I apologize for that inconvenience. Let me just double-check the main return policy here... one moment.

Okay, I'm looking at our knowledge base now. It says here that all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. My apologies, the 10-day rule must be for something else. You are well within the 90-day period.
Right. So, are you going to send me the label or not?
Yes, absolutely. I'm processing the return for a full refund right now. I've just sent the prepaid shipping label to the email address on file. You should receive it within the next 5 minutes.
Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
